ThingDef.label: bandit cache map
ThingDef.description: A stained scrap of parchment covered in false landmarks, coded marks, and a few convincing directions. It claims to point toward goods hidden by outlaws, though a buyer has no way to know whether the cache is real, already picked clean, or guarded.

ThingDef.label: stolen ledger
ThingDef.description: A compact book of half-erased names, debts, delivery marks, and coded tally lines. Traders treat it as a curiosity, but fences and informants know it may be worth more than the paper it is written on.
